text.text_excerpt: I love candy even though I know sugar is bad for me. I was drawn into IT'SUGAR by the giant candy boxes they had displayed in their window. They have lots of interesting candy, including a whole bunch of unique and "gourmet" gummy bear flavors that you can purchase by the pound in bulk. I picked out two of each flavor that sounded interesting (including some cocktail flavored ones) and also got a bunch of tiny mini gummy bears (I can't resist those). I also got some 3D gummies which I had never seen before (but when you think about it, it makes sense so why do You not see them more?). I tried to be mindful of my bag weight but I didn't see any scales anywhere so it can add up quickly. The...

HOLY SUGAR DIABETIS. WOW, it's the FLAVOR FLAV of candy stores BOOOOOOYYYY! FRANK gives a personal double thumbs up rating if you care or not!!! You can feel the rush of adrenaline as you enter the door of candy land. It's either that or your heightened senses are in overdrive from all the sugar particles in the air. It's Sugar sell's everything you cold ever want for candy lover's of the universe. Such a cute shop! This place is a candy lovers dream and offers all types of yummy candy gifts such as giant Reese's cups, giant Hershey bars, extra long Twizzlers, giant gummy bears and pocky along with tons more. The shop is small and they do have some candy that you can pile into bags and buy, but the main attraction here is all of the unique candy themed gifts and things like that. Some really cute things that I had to resist purchasing was the plush ketchup and french fries that had smiley faces, a plush ice cream cone and pillows that were made to look like candy.
